title: Quantization sensitivity & noise-injection calibration for reranker ranking-quality
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Runbook and automation to validate FP8/INT8 quantization profiles for the reranker model using slice-aware calibration and noise-injection to estimate sensitivity. The goal is to have a reproducible gating workflow that flags quality regressions in NDCG@10 and MRR per slice and overall, with statistical guarantees and a clear rollback plan. This ticket builds on the calibration infra in reranker-quantization-tooling and adds: (1) noise-injection stress sweeps during calibration to approximate worst-case scale perturbations, (2) slicewise evaluation and bootstrap confidence intervals, and (3) CI gating thresholds and automated PR checks that mark quant profiles as candidate/approved/blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Implement noise-injection calibration runner: accepts noise-levels and weight/activation targets; runnable via ci/quant_calib_runner.sh
Add slice-aware evaluation harness that computes NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR with 95% bootstrap CIs per slice
Define and document gating criteria: max absolute NDCG@10 drop <= 0.5% or p-value > 0.05 for paired bootstrap test; otherwise mark profile as 'blocked'
Create CI job reranker-quant-eval (runs on PRs modifying quant profiles) and surface results in PR status with links to dashboard
Provide rollback playbook that maps failing layers to candidate mitigations: layer-wise re-calibration, per-channel symmetric INT8, fallback FP16/FP32 for flagged layers
steps: Prototype noise injection: add gaussian noise to layer weights during calibration (sigma sweep: 0%, 0.5%, 1%, 2%, 5%)
Extend existing calib pipeline to support: per-layer clipping, per-channel scales, and FP8 variants (E4M3, E5M2) and INT8 asymmetric/symmetric modes
Generate evaluation slices: head queries, tail low-frequency queries, multilingual, long context (>512 tokens), short queries (<32 tokens), and query paraphrase clusters
Run baseline (FP16) and candidate quant profiles across samples of 50k queries stratified by slice
Compute metrics: NDCG@1/3/10, MRR, pairwise swap rate, and token-latency differences
Perform paired bootstrap (N=1000) to compute 95% confidence intervals and two-sided p-values for NDCG deltas
Record per-layer sensitivity by doing ablation: revert one layer to FP16 and measure delta; present top 10 sensitive layers
If a profile fails gating, create a candidate mitigations PR (options: reduce global scale, clamp outliers, switch to per-channel symmetric INT8, or fallback FP16 for sensitive layers)
metrics: Pass rate target for candidate profiles: >= 95% of production-like slices must meet gating criteria
Max allowed absolute NDCG@10 drop (any single slice): 1.0%
Median MRR delta must be within +/-0.003 relative to baseline
95% bootstrap CI width for NDCG@10 should be < 0.4 percentage points for main slices
Latency improvement goal: token-level serving cost reduction >= 18% vs FP16 for profiles that pass
experiments: E1: Baseline FP16 run on 50k stratified queries (control)
E2: INT8 symmetric per-channel calib with KL clipping + noise sigma 0.5%
E3: INT8 asymmetric per-tensor calib with 1% noise-injection
E4: FP8 E4M3 profile with per-layer clamp and 0%/0.5%/1% noise sweep
E5: Hybrid profile: FP8 for most layers, INT8 for top-3 sensitive layers
E6: Adversarial tails test: tail-user subset under 5k queries with outlier-heavy distributions
